cp8:1.1: Ariṭṭhasa' vhaye nagare Sivi nām' āsiṃ khattiyo nisajja pāsādavare evaṃ cintes' ahaṃ tadā: || ||
cp8:2.1: Yaṃ kiñci mānusaṃ dānaṃ adinnaṃ me na vijjati yo pi yāceyya maṃ cakkhuṃ dadeyyaṃ avikampito. || ||
cp8:3.1: Mama saṅkappam-aññāya Sakko devānam-issaro nisinno devaparisāya idaṃ vacanam-abravi: || ||
cp8:4.1: Nisajja pāsādavare Sivirājā mah' iddhiko cintento vividhaṃ dānaṃ adeyyaṃ so na passati. || ||
cp8:5.1: Tathaṃ nu vitathannetaṃ handa vīmaṃsayāmi taṃ muhuttaṃ āgameyyātha yāva jānāmi taṃ manaṃ. || ||
cp8:6.1: Pavedhamāno palitasiro valitagatto jarāturo andhavaṇṇo va hutvāna rājānaṃ upasaṅkami. || ||
cp8:7.1: So tadā paggahetvāna vāmaṃ dakkhiṇabāhu ca sirasmiṃ añjaliṃ katvā idaṃ vacanam-abravi: || ||
cp8:8.1: Yācāmi taṃ mahārāja dhammika raṭṭhavaḍḍhana tava dānaratā kitti uggatā devamānuse. || ||
cp8:9.1: Ubho pi nettā nayanā andhā upahatā mama ekaṃ me nayanaṃ dehi tvam-pi ekena yāpaya. || ||
cp8:10.1: Tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā haṭṭho saṃviggamānaso kata' ñjalī vedajāto idaṃ vacanam-abraviṃ: || ||
cp8:11.1: Idān' āhaṃ cintayitvāna pāsādato idhāgato tvaṃ mama cittam-aññāya nettaṃ yācitum-āgato. || ||
cp8:12.1: Aho me mānasaṃ siddhaṃ saṅkappo paripūrito adinnapubbaṃ dānavaraṃ ajja dassāmi yācake. || ||
cp8:13.1: Ehi Sīvaka uṭṭhehi mā dandhayi mā pavedhayi ubho pi nayane dehi uppāṭetvā vaṇibbake. || ||
cp8:14.1: Tato so codito mayhaṃ Sīvako vacanaṅkaro uddharitvāna pādāsi tālamiñjaṃ va yācake. || ||
cp8:15.1: Dadamānassa dentassa dinnadānassa me sato cittassa aññathā natthi bodhiyā-yeva kāraṇā. || ||
cp8:16.1: Na me dessā ubho cakkhū attā na me na dessiyo sabbaññutaṃ piyaṃ mayhaṃ tasmā cakkhuṃ adās' ahan-ti. || ||
